_comment: Frozen, versioned snapshot of the evaluation numbers actually cited in docs/evaluation_plan.md and the thesis writeup. evaluation/results/ (raw per-case JSON, all charts, all sample runs) stays gitignored because it's fully regenerable by rerunning the scripts below against the current DB/prompts -- but regeneration depends on live, non-deterministic Gemini calls, so the specific numbers used in the write-up need a frozen copy that survives independent of any future rerun. This directory is that copy.

entries.description: Week 3 pilot experiment, single-agent vs multi-agent, n=10 (per arm).
Week 4 full experiment, n=50 (per arm), BEFORE the mcq_v1.2 question-leak fix. This is the 'before' half of the mcq_v1.1 vs mcq_v1.2 before/after comparison in docs/evaluation_plan.md.
entries.note: Superseded as the 'current' result by week4_full_50_summary_mcq_v1.2_final.csv -- kept only for the before/after comparison.

entries.description: Week 4 full experiment, n=50 (per arm), FINAL: mcq_v1.2 (partial question-leak fix) + tutor_mcq_v1.1/single_agent_baseline_v1.1 (the 'Dataset-correct option'/'Option 0/1/2' debug-leak fix). This is the current canonical Week 4 result.
Per-case, per-system flat detail behind week4_full_50_summary_mcq_v1.2_final.csv (question/options/hint/explanation/automated_checks for all 100 rows).
Token usage comparison chart for week4_full_50_summary_mcq_v1.2_final.csv.
API call count comparison chart for week4_full_50_summary_mcq_v1.2_final.csv.

LLM-as-a-Judge scores for all 48 items (24 cases x 2 systems) in the blinded human-eval set, same 5-criterion rubric as the human raters. Backs the 'ceiling effect' finding in docs/evaluation_plan.md. Post-fix (mcq_v1.2 + tutor_mcq_v1.1/single_agent_baseline_v1.1).
Same data as llm_judge_scores.csv, full structured form with per-criterion justifications and the free-text 'concerns' field.
